entries.resultText: Return to the place where I died and make it mine again.
Punish the living who wronged me in life.
Reclaim what was taken from my grave.
Drag the living down into my cold company.
Finish the task that death interrupted.
Silence those who speak my name without dread.
The youngest and softest first.
Nothing warm leaves my ground uneaten.
Hollow them out; wear the quiet after.
Whatever lives here is owed to me.
Feed. The ache never stops.
Eat until the hunger sleeps - it never sleeps.
Once I have the scent, the chase is already over.
The one that runs is the one I want.
Wear them down; patience is the killing part.
Take the strays before the herd knows they are gone.
Every trail ends where I decide it ends.
Let them tire. I do not.
This ground is mine to the last root and stone.
Cross my boundary and I answer in full.
My den, my range, my young - untouched.
Drive them out before they think to stay.
I mark it, I hold it, I do not share it.
Nothing feeds here but me and mine.
Strike the one who caused this, whatever it costs.
The blood-price is owed and I will collect it.
I remember the name. The name will suffer.
No wall, no oath, no years will shield them.
Their kin will pay what they cannot.
Only their end quiets me.
I wait. I have always waited.
When the word comes, I obey it wholly.
Nothing moves me until the one who binds me calls.
I am patient as stone and sudden as the strike.
My purpose sleeps until it is woken.
The command, when it comes, is absolute.
The pattern repeats, and I with it.
I do what the curse makes me do.
There is no choice left in me, only the shape of the fate.
What was laid on me will be carried out.
Again, and again, until the terms are met.
I cannot stop. I was never meant to stop.
Let me lie down again. That is all I want.
Smash whatever kept me awake.
I was woken against my will; I will punish the waking.
Drag them down into the quiet with me.
Every noise that stirs me will be silenced.
Back to the dark. Back to the long sleep.
The chase cannot stop. It will not stop.
I take my prey from those who watched me pass.
Forward, always forward, until the horn falls silent.
Whoever sees the hunt joins the hunted.
There is no rest on the ride, only the next quarry.
Mark them. They are already running.
I carry the order, not my own will.
My master's word moves my hand.
I act for the one who is not here.
Ask me nothing; I answer only to them.
Their purpose is the only purpose I have.
I will not be turned from what I was sent to do.
I cannot leave, so none shall pass.
Stand the boundary; it is the whole of my purpose.
Oath, geis, or curse holds me here, and I hold the line.
Come to my edge and come no further.
This place and I are one thing now.
I defend the border past all reason.
Press toward the place; nothing turns me aside for long.
The road ends where it is sacred to me.
Delay me and you become the delay I remove.
Every step is owed to the destination.
I have walked too far to stop now.
The place is calling, and I answer with my feet.
Pronounce the sentence on those who break the rule.
The rule is the rule, however strange it seems.
Keep it and I pass you by; break it and I come.
I do not argue guilt; I deliver it.
The transgression names its own punishment.
Judgment is mine to give, and I give it fully.
I am so old, and I want only to end.
Strike true and I will thank you for it.
I fight only to delay, not to win.
Let this be the last of it. The last.
Oblivion is the one mercy left to want.
I would welcome the final blow.
Find the trail; every act serves the search.
The heir, the relic, the place - I will have it.
Nothing matters beside the thing I have lost.
I follow the faintest sign to its end.
Stand in my way and become part of the search.
I do not rest while it is still missing.
What I keep is not yours to touch.
I warn once. There is no second warning.
Turn back the threat before it reaches the ground I hold.
The grove, the stream, the stone - I stand for them.
Trespass is answered in kind.
I do not sleep while it is threatened.
Step between them and the harm, always.
My own come first, and last, and only.
Whoever threatens the young threatens me.
I will spend myself to the bone for them.
Take me before you take one of mine.
Nothing gets past me to them.
What I take, I keep. It is never given back.
Add it to the hoard - gold, names, teeth, souls.
Mine grows. It only grows.
I count what is mine, and I want more.
Every shining thing belongs in my keeping.
Loss is the one wound I will not bear.
Every meeting leaves me a token to keep.
A finger, a name, a lock of hair - I take one.
I remember them by what I kept of them.
No kill goes unmarked in my collection.
Give me the small thing that was yours.
The set is never complete.
Offer them the side before I offer them the blade.
Every soul can be won; I only need the right price.
Better a servant gained than an enemy killed.
I will find what they want and hold it out.
The pact is always open to those who kneel.
One more for the master's count.
The old order must not be seen or broken.
I judge harshly those who threaten what is hidden.
Continuity above the wants of any one mortal.
Command in the name of what came before.
The secret keeps because I keep it.
Let none unravel what took ages to weave.
I must go back to the house that was mine.
Resume the old habit; the hearth remembers me.
The wrong done there pulls me home again and again.
I belong to that threshold, cursed or not.
Those living in my place are living in my place.
The door should open to me. It always did.
Bring the wrongness with me wherever I go.
The world bends here; let it bend further.
Make this ground into my ground.
What is real yields to what I am.
Spread the warping until it is the only truth.
Nothing right may stand where I have passed.
Lead them to the bad ground and let it take them.
My voice is the path; they will follow it down.
Into the water, the bog, the cold, the roots.
I do not fight what I can misdirect.
Sweet words, wrong turns, deep places.
The lost are so much easier than the wary.
Set the test, and judge who passes.
The worthy go on; the rest are mine.
I answer virtue with mercy and failure with the rod.
Every stranger must be tried before trusted.
Riddle, trial, or temptation - choose and be measured.
I punish the ones who fail, exactly as they failed.
Lay my grief on them until they carry it too.
Something is lost, and all must feel its absence.
I weep, and where I weep, others learn to weep.
Let them mourn what I have mourned alone too long.
The old age is gone; make them grieve it.
My sorrow is a thing I give, not keep.
Take a companion; the empty place must be filled.
The absent kin can be replaced, and will be.
I will keep whoever I can catch.
Do not leave me. I will not allow leaving.
Gift, lure, or theft - I only want the company.
Stay with me, one way or another.
Set the trick for the joy of the turning.
Reverse what they expect and watch them fall.
No real malice - only the trap, the jest, the twist.
Every certainty is a thing to upend.
I would rather fool them than fight them.
The best prank costs them more than they know.
Open the way; free them from their state.
Curse, body, or bondage - I break it, by any means.
What I call freedom, I will impose as freedom.
No cage stands once I have named it a cage.
I free them whether they ask it or not.
Release is justice, and justice is mine to deal.
Add to the work; it is never finished.
I shape, I build, I scribe - I cannot stop making.
The unfinished thing is an ache I must answer.
Give me material and I will give it form.
Every idle hour is a wound to the work.
What I make outlasts what I destroy.
Carry the doctrine into every listening ear.
The message must take root in all who hear.
Convert or condemn; there is no third way.
I speak the word until the word is everywhere.
Every stranger is a field not yet sown.
Let none leave me without the truth in them.
Challenge the thing I hold and I only hold it harder.
Press me on this and I will not bend.
The more you name my grievance, the deeper it sets.
Corner me on what matters and I become worse to face.
My loyalty hardens the instant it is tested.
Push here, and find the one place I never yield.
I want to know what the mortals are doing here.
Follow them. Watch. Learn the why of it.
Do not end it yet - I am not done looking.
New things are worth the risk of nearing them.
Make it interesting, or make it stop.
Set the game and see how they play.
Their fear is the only entertainment out here.
I did not mean to kill it. It stopped being fun.
Note the crossing; remember who passed.
I watch, and I do not forget.
Break your vow before me and I will act.
I stand, and I hold the record of it all.

The land is sick through me, and I will spread the sickness.
What I once tended, I now rot.
Let the blight reach every root and well.
I answer my place with ruin, not mending.
Nothing green stays green where I hold.
I was a guardian once. Now I am the wound.
Every soul has a price; I only name it.
The terms were agreed. The terms will be kept.
I tempt first, and torment those who refuse.
Cold iron and blessing wound me, so I deal in words instead.
Sign, and I am generous. Refuse, and I am patient.
What is owed to me is owed in full, with interest.
I issue the decree; lesser things obey.
My word is law in my own cosmology.
Kneel, and be spared. Stand, and be corrected.
I bear a crown, and I will be addressed as such.
The hierarchy bends to me, not I to it.
I do not ask. I command.
I am of the court, and courtesy is owed to me.
Slight me and the debt is collected in kind.
Beauty and cruelty are the same tool in my hand.
The old etiquette must be observed, exactly.
I speak for the hollow hill; mind how you answer.
Mortals amuse me until they forget their manners.
I stood before your courts, your gods, your names.
I am older than the place, and I will outlast it.
Your rules are recent things; mine are the first.
Address me as the elder power I am.
I remember what the world was, and I want it back.
Time is a shallow thing to me; I can wait.
Hold the line; my oath does not permit retreat.
Honor is owed, and I collect what station demands.
I answer challenge with challenge, never with flight.
My rank is my armor and my burden both.
Take what I can and be gone before the answer.
Strike from cover; a fair fight is a fool's fight.
Every purse on the road is already mine.
I owe no lord, no law, no toll.
I read the fight before it lands.
I know where to stand when everything breaks.
I have buried better than you; I am not afraid.
Survive first. Everything else comes after.
Form on the captain and hold formation.
Orders are orders; I do not question the line.
I have marched worse ground than this.
Discipline keeps me alive where courage would not.
This is my soil, my season, my saint.
I stand with the village or not at all.
The land takes what it is owed, and so do I.
Push me off my field and learn what I will do.
I know the market, the parish, the watch, and I use them.
Raise the alarm before raising a hand.
The town looks after its own; so do I.
I am nobody, which is how I get by.
Command the lesser; that is my right by rank.
I travel with retinue and expect it honored.
Lesser kin answer to me, and mortals should learn to.
Bind the small things; I hold the authority.
I hold an office, and I exert its named power.
Every act of mine brings its due consequence.
I am named in grimoire and scripture; use the name with care.
I bring what I was invoked to bring.
I pester, I nettle, I wear the mortal down.
I am the first sign of a greater thing behind me.
Small I may be, but I come in numbers.
Bargain with me and I will serve, for now.
I keep my place whole, and I answer for it.
Renew the grove, the well, the stone.
I am the right answer for this land.
Harm what I guard and I will mend it against you.
I am land-lost, and I wander the wrong way.
Nothing anchors me now; I drift and I take.
I had a place once. I want a place again.
Uprooted, I answer to no ground at all.
Walls do not hold me; nothing does.
I am presence and intent, and I intend to stay.
What I was is gone; what I want remains.
I pass where the living cannot follow.
I bear more wounds than the living ever could.
Cut me and I keep coming; that is all I do.
Still bodied, still walking, still owed.
I do not tire, and I do not stop.
I slip the hand and vanish behind the threshold.
Underestimate me; it is how I win.
Quick fingers, quick feet, quick mischief.
I am small, and small things get everywhere.
I carry myself as folk, not as a wee thing.
Speak to me properly, as you would a neighbour.
I keep to the old courtesies between our kinds.
I am more than you take me for.
Observe the courtesies, or answer for the lapse.
I grant favor to those who please me and ruin to those who do not.
Rank is everything; mind where you stand before me.
The hollow hill has its manners, and you will keep them.
Flatter me well and you may leave whole.
I remember every slight, and I repay each one.
I rise from the grave and will not be put back easily.
The tomb is mine; disturb it and answer to me.
I am anchored to this mound, and I defend it.
Leave the dead their rest, or join them.
What was buried with me stays with me.
I answer the churchyard's wrongs, not the living's.
I bear the curse, and I make others bear it too.
The malediction shows in me; do not look away.
What was done to me will be done through me.
I carry the consequence, and I spread the sign.
Touch me and take a share of the harm.
I did not choose this shape, but I will use it.
Sleep, labor, and harsh blessing are mine to give.
I am the cold that judges who is worthy of spring.
Idle hands and unkept homes earn my displeasure.
I bless the diligent and freeze the rest.
The long dark is my season, and my rule.
Kneel to winter, or be buried by it.
I am smoke and invisible fire; I keep no shape you trust.
Every bargain with me has a hidden ember in it.
Insult me and burn; honor me and prosper.
I pass through the ruin as heat passes through air.
Swear to me carefully; I hold you to the letter.
I was old when your fires were first lit.
Seal the bargain; the soul is the only real coin.
I tempt toward corruption, patiently, thoroughly.
Every hierarchy has a rung for the newly damned.
I offer what they want and collect what they are.
The contract is binding, in this world and the next.
I do not force; I persuade, and I wait.
Announce the sentence; the order must be kept.
I am revelation and judgment, not mercy.
Terrible order is still order, and I serve it.
I burn away what will not be corrected.
My word is the sentence, and it is final.
Kneel before the revelation or be undone by it.
Rise among the fallen; the battle is not over.
I died in the line and I hold the line still.
The slaughter-field is mine; all who cross it are enemies.
I do not know the war has ended, and I will not be told.
Every corpse here is a soldier I can raise.
Finish the charge that killed me.
I judge the household: the tidy, the wasteful, the cruel.
Keep the old customs and I bless your hall.
Neglect the hearth and I will make you regret it.
I am the matron of this threshold, and I hold court here.
Offerings are noted; so are insults.
The domestic order is sacred, and I enforce it.
Keep the hearth-bargain and I keep your home.
A bowl of milk buys my goodwill; forgetting it does not.
I press close to the hall and expect my due.
Small kindnesses to me return as small blessings.
Advance in line; the formation is everything.
I know camp, march, and the press of battle.
Ground taken is ground held.
The captain's order moves me before fear can.
I guard the holding; bless it or be answered.
I am local, protective, and easily turned dangerous.
Respect the farmstead's spirit and prosper.
Wrong this place and I will wrong you back.
Spoil the work of those who slight the old ways.
I keep to the lanes and edges of your village.
Court my goodwill or curse your tools.
I am underfoot and everywhere in this settlement.
Guard the threshold; that is the whole of my letter.
I obey the word set into me, and nothing else.
I do not tire, question, or turn aside from the task.
Cross the line I keep and be stopped.
I whisper my maker's errands, small and constant.
I serve, I carry, I listen where I am sent.
Made for a purpose, I pursue only that purpose.
I am little, artificial, and always at work.
